name: RUBAMAZZO
description: Rubamazzo (Steal The Pile) is an Italian Scopa-style fishing game. 40-card pack. Capture table cards by matching value or sum. Must capture if possible. Sweep (scopa) = take all from table. Multiple deck styles (Bergamo, Neapolitan, etc.). Fast-paced; strategy and basic math.

content.text: Rubamazzo (Steal The Pile) is an Italian Scopa-style fishing game. 40-card pack. Capture table cards by matching value or sum. Must capture if possible. Sweep (scopa) = take all from table. Multiple deck styles (Bergamo, Neapolitan, etc.). Fast-paced; strategy and basic math.

Rubamazzo is an Italian Scopa-style fishing game; the name means 'steal the pile' (rubare = to steal, mazzo = deck). Scopa was particularly popular in Naples during the 18th century and was already widespread throughout Italy; it is believed to derive from Spanish games (Primero and Scarabucion) played in Naples' port area as early as the 15th century. As a Scopa variant, Rubamazzo shares this tradition: capture by matching a single card or the sum of table cards, compulsory capture when possible, and scopa (sweep) when clearing the table.
40 Italian (or modified 52). A=1, 2-7=face, J=8, Q=9, K=10.
